crossRefs.note: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh, which he will work for you…
So Yahweh saved Israel that day; and the battle passed over by Beth Aven.
Thus Yahweh saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria and from…
Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.
He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and in his pity he…
Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of…
The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
For, behold, your enemies, Yahweh, for, behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Thus Yahweh saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.
translations.bsb: That day the LORD saved Israel from the hand of the Egyptians, and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the shore.
translations.kjv: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.
translations.asv: Thus Jehovah saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea-shore.
